import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'

def write_project(name, source):
    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
[package]
name="{name}"
version="0.1.0"

[[target.bin]]
name="{name}"
path="src/main.fzy"
'''))
    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
    return root

clean = write_project('stdlib_policy_clean', '''
    use core.http;
    use core.thread;
    fn worker() -> i32 { return 1 }
    fn main() -> i32 {
        let payload = map.new()
        discard map.set(payload, "ok", json.str("true"))
        let handle = spawn(worker)
        discard join(handle)
        return 0
    }
''')
clean_build = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'build', str(clean), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
clean_payload = json.loads(clean_build.stdout.strip())
assert clean_build.returncode == 0 and clean_payload['status'] == 'ok', (clean_build.returncode, clean_payload, clean_build.stderr)
policy = json.loads((clean / '.fz' / 'stdlib-capability-policy.json').read_text())
assert policy['schemaVersion'] == 'fozzylang.stdlib_capability_policy.v1', policy
assert policy['capabilityPolicy']['propagation'] == 'explicit_compiler_checked', policy
assert any(item['module'] == 'core.http' for item in policy['modules']), policy
assert any(item['module'] == 'core.json' for item in policy['modules']), policy
assert any(item['kind'] == 'json_raw_composite_or_dynamic_injection' for item in policy['strictHazards']), policy
policy_md = (clean / '.fz' / 'stdlib-capability-policy.md').read_text()
assert '## Module Contracts' in policy_md, policy_md
assert '## Strict Hazards' in policy_md, policy_md

hazards = write_project('stdlib_policy_hazards', '''
    use core.fs;
    use core.proc;
    use core.http;
    use core.security;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        discard fs.write_file("../secrets.txt", "oops")
        discard fs.write_file("/tmp/out.txt", "tmp")
        discard proc.argv_push(proc.argv_new(), "-c")
        discard proc.spawn_cmd("/bin/sh", proc.argv_new(), proc.env_new(), "")
        discard http.header_set("X-Demo", "ok")
        discard map.set(map.new(), "body", json.raw("{\"unsafe\":true}"))
        let signer = security.default_signer()
        if security.sign(signer, "k", "v") == security.sign(signer, "k", "v") {
            return 0
        }
        return 1
    }
''')
hazard_verify = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'verify', str(hazards), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
hazard_payload = json.loads(hazard_verify.stdout.strip())
assert hazard_verify.returncode == 0, (hazard_verify.returncode, hazard_payload, hazard_verify.stderr)
messages = [item['message'] for item in hazard_payload['items']]
assert any('json.raw(...)` embeds a composite or quoted JSON literal' in message for message in messages), messages
assert any('traversal-prone literal path `../secrets.txt`' in message for message in messages), messages
assert any('writes directly to temp path `/tmp/out.txt`' in message for message in messages), messages
assert any('process argv uses shell command-string flag' in message for message in messages), messages
assert any('shells out through `/bin/sh`' in message for message in messages), messages
assert any('HTTP header `X-Demo` is not normalized' in message for message in messages), messages
assert any('secret-bearing values are compared with `==`/`!=`' in message for message in messages), messages
print('compiler-stdlib-capability-policy-ok')
